main.changes_reassign: Changes reassign the entire current interval, including its elapsed time. You can change this in Settings.
main.search_projects_hint: Filter projects by name. Searching does not change the activity.
main.activity_unavailable: The selected project or task is archived, finished or removed. Choose another activity.
main.add_projects_hint: Add projects in the Projects section below, or track Unassigned focus.

main.all_time_total.one: All projects, all time (saved): {duration} in {count} session
main.all_time_total.other: All projects, all time (saved): {duration} in {count} sessions

main.recovery_saved: An interrupted session was saved up to its last checkpoint.
main.recovery_excluded: Time after that checkpoint is excluded. Tracking has not resumed.
main.tray_double_click: Double-click the tray icon to start or stop.
main.tray_click: Click the tray icon to show this window. Hover to see tracked time.
settings.title: Application settings
settings.split_on_change: Start a new interval when project or task changes
settings.split_on_change_hint: When off, a change corrects the current interval instead: all its time moves to the new project or task.
settings.split_at_midnight: Start a new interval at midnight
settings.split_at_midnight_hint: Ends a running interval when the local day changes and continues it as a new one. Time totals stay the same.
startup.in_tray: Start in tray when launched at sign-in
startup.manual_launch_hint: Manual launches show the window. Tracking always starts stopped.
startup.points_elsewhere: Startup points to another copy or different options.
projects.new_project_hint: New project name. Paste several, one per line.
projects.none_yet: No projects yet. You can still track Unassigned focus.
projects.rename_hint: Earlier sessions keep the name they recorded.
projects.delete_hint: Never tracked, so it can be removed.
projects.new_task_hint: New task. Paste several, one per line.
projects.archive_hint: Archived projects leave the pickers. Their history stays in reports.
reports.title: Focus history and reports
reports.custom_hint: Keep the current dates when the day changes.
reports.period_today_hint: Follows the current day: moves to the new date at midnight ({timezone}).

reports.period_days_hint.one: Follows the current day: always the last {count} days ({timezone}).
reports.period_days_hint.other: Follows the current day: always the last {count} days ({timezone}).

reports.period_fixed_hint: Fixed dates: this range stays as entered when the day changes. Choose Today to follow the current day.
reports.auto_refresh: Auto-refresh: tracking is inside this range
reports.auto_refresh_paused: Auto-refresh paused: no tracking time is growing in this range
reports.loads_automatically: The report loads automatically when history is ready.
reports.running_now_hint: Time of the interval still running, inside this period. It moves to Saved focus when the interval ends.
reports.interrupted_hint: Time saved up to the last checkpoint of an interval that was cut off, such as by a crash or a clock change. It counts once you choose Accept saved time in the main window.
reports.invalid_interval: Session {id} has an invalid wall interval; its duration is excluded.
reports.showing_recent: Showing the 200 most recent sessions. Totals include all matching sessions.
reports.clipped_hint: Session time below is clipped to the selected period.
charts.no_time: No tracked time in this period.

charts.too_long.one: This view covers up to {count} days. Choose a shorter period, or use Weekly rhythm.
charts.too_long.other: This view covers up to {count} days. Choose a shorter period, or use Weekly rhythm.

errors.recovery_unconfirmed: Cannot confirm saving before the Windows interruption. Check session recovery.
errors.export_exists: Choose a new filename; existing files are never overwritten.

errors.too_many_days: Choose at most 3,660 days per report.
errors.too_many_commands: Too many tracking commands are waiting. Try again shortly.
errors.tracking_stopped: Tracking stopped responding. Restart the application.
errors.tracking_unavailable: Tracking is unavailable. Resolve the storage error and restart.
errors.absolute_path_required: Use an absolute path without parent components.
errors.startup_path_unicode: Startup path must be valid Unicode.
errors.startup_path_absolute: Startup requires an absolute executable path without quotes or NUL.
errors.startup_command_long: The Windows startup command exceeds 260 characters. Move the EXE to a shorter path.
